The 12 weekly chapters contain lessons on the key grammatical structures and present a range of useful vocabulary, along with exercises to reinforce your learning. The grammar essentials of the new language are clearly explained and tested in conversational exercises, giving you the authentic feel of the language.

Whether you’re learning a new language for work, a future holiday, or because you’re interested in languages, this course is the perfect place to start. Learning a new language has never been so easy!

Languages covered in this release:
- French
- Spanish
- Italian
- Portuguese
- German
- Dutch
